landing.heroDescription: Upload an image, adjust precision, and generate pixel art patterns with one click — a simple and practical bead pattern tool.
landing.feature1Desc: Supports Cartoon and Realistic modes with flexible control over grid precision and color merge thresholds.
landing.feature2Desc: Multiple preset bead palettes, custom palette management, and support for various color code systems.
landing.feature3Desc: One-click noise exclusion with smart remapping to nearby available colors, keeping the image clean.
landing.feature4Desc: Fine-tune every pixel cell with tools like brush, eraser, and color replacement.
landing.feature5Desc: Gamified bead assistant with color guidance, progress tracking, and smart recommendations.
landing.feature6Desc: Download annotated patterns and shopping lists, with CSV data import/export support.
landing.step1Desc: Supports JPG, PNG images or CSV data file import.
landing.step2Desc: Tune grid precision and color merge threshold, select palette and processing mode.
landing.step3Desc: Preview the result, then download the annotated pattern and shopping list.
